body: I don't know if it is more appropriate to link to https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-promise where you write "promise" or not, but I noticed you did do that for "object" in this same note. (Of course "promise" is more conversational than "object" anyways.)

I think linking `Promise<T>` would be reasonable, but "promise" isn't connected enough to that definition.

I'll file another editorial issue for linking `Promise<T>` globally.
